facts.fact: The Direction Generale des Douanes says SYDONIA World has been the central platform dematerialising customs procedures, in operation since 2018.

The Direction Generale des Douanes says a UNCTAD expert's functional and technical audit of SYDONIA World defined the evolutions needed to strengthen its performance, interoperability and security, with the aim of evolving it into a more integrated platform.

note: The single window is described only as a needs assessment for its deployment, not as in service; no exchange of data with another country's customs is stated.

facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports that the customs information system SYDONIA was interconnected with the tax system SIGIT in a launch on 30 December 2023, with customs operator data cross-checked against tax records.

note: The document states nothing this study asks for Comoros.

facts.fact: AFD states its EUR 10m PAGF-SI project, from 7 December 2023, updates the Comoros finance administration applications including SYDONIA to improve their interfacing.
UNCTAD says Comoros customs procedures remain only partially digitalized despite the deployment of SYDONIAWorld, and its programme is to digitalize further customs procedures.
UNCTAD says the first phase of the Guichet Unique du Commerce Extérieur (GUCE) has been deployed in Comoros, and its programme is to expand GUCE to additional border agencies.

note: The document states nothing on this study's aspects for this country that the study's questions ask.

facts.fact: The finance ministry's notice of 26 June 2026 on the close of the AFD- and EU-backed PAGF says the project strengthened the interface between SYDONIA and SIGIT for smoother tax and customs data.
The UN Global Survey 2025 records the Automated Customs System in Comoros as fully implemented, with e-submission of customs declarations partially implemented.

note: No e-single window or cross-border exchange: both recorded as not implemented.

facts.fact: TACD CARTENA says SYDONIA is one of the four main applications of the Comorian finance ministry's financial information system, alongside SIGIT, SIM-BA and GISE.

note: Database record only; system claim held, portal line is a no contradicted by a primary.
